title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.30181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite substantial progress in Deep Search agents, their ability to conduct end-to-end research in real-world open Web environments remains insufficiently evaluated. Unlike static retrieval settings, information on the real-world Web is distributed across diverse sources, modalities, and heterogeneous formats, often involving complex interaction mechanisms that require agents to autonomously search for, access, and integrate relevant evidence during execution. To address this gap, we introduce the OpenDS task, designed to evaluate agents' ability to perform multi-step deep search in the live, open Web. This task requires agents to autonomously explore the real Web, discover and connect relevant evidence from multiple independent sources through Web search, browser interaction, and evidence processing, and ultimately determine a unique factual answer. translated_title: 真实世界网络环境中的深度搜索
translated_abstract: 尽管深度搜索智能体已取得长足进步，但其在真实世界开放网络环境中进行端到端研究的能力仍未得到充分评估。与静态检索设置不同，真实网络中的信息分布在多样的来源、模态和异构格式之中，通常涉及复杂的交互机制，要求智能体在执行过程中自主地搜索、访问并整合相关证据。为填补这一空白，我们提出了 OpenDS 任务，旨在评估智能体在实时、开放的网络中进行多步骤深度搜索的能力。该任务要求智能体自主探索真实网络，通过网络搜索、浏览器交互和证据处理，从多个独立来源中发现并关联相关证据，并最终确定唯一的事实性答案。基于该任务设定，我们构建了 OpenDS-World，这是一个包含 20（原文摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了 OpenDS 任务及 OpenDS-World 基准，用于评估智能体在真实、开放的互联网环境中自主进行多步骤深度搜索、跨多个独立来源发现并整合证据，从而得出唯一事实性答案的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OpenDS, a new task and benchmark (OpenDS-World) designed to evaluate agents' ability to autonomously perform multi-step deep search in the live, open Web, discovering and integrating evidence from diverse independent sources to arrive at unique factual answers.
